readMeFirst: This file is the single source of truth for where delivery stands. tests/delivery-ledger.test.ts keeps it honest; update it in the same commit as the work it describes.

statusMeaning.merged: On main. Every path in files and tests must exist and every prerequisite must also be merged.
statusMeaning.in-review: Complete on a branch with an open pull request; pr names it. Paths are not checked on this branch.
statusMeaning.todo: Not started. Paths are the plan's intent, not a promise about names.
statusMeaning.removed: Withdrawn from the design; the reason is in note.
